validacion-biometrica.title: AI-Powered Biometric Validation
validacion-biometrica.shortDescription: Facial recognition + liveness detection with AWS Rekognition, integrated with RENAPER

engineer.description: Complete solution (backend + frontend) for identity validation through facial recognition with liveness detection, integrated with RENAPER and with immutable traceability on AWS QLDB.
highlights: 500+ daily verifications in production, 99.8% precision
Node.js/NestJS backend integrated with RENAPER, Angular frontend
Immutable traceability with AWS QLDB

billetera-virtual.title: Core API — TotalCoin virtual wallet
billetera-virtual.shortDescription: Core API and microservices for TotalCoin's virtual wallet and payment gateway

engineer.description: Development of the Core API and microservices infrastructure for TotalCoin's virtual wallet and payment gateway. Multi-level authorization flow for 4 commercial sub-wallets, and migration of 3 legacy microservices to Docker/ECS.
highlights: Multi-level signer/approver module for 4 commercial sub-wallets
CQRS, Facade and Mediator patterns on DDD
3 legacy microservices migrated to Docker/ECS: -40% deployment time

monitoreo-agricola.title: Agricultural monitoring with Machine Learning
monitoreo-agricola.shortDescription: Crop monitoring app with ML and IoT traceability on AWS QLDB (Spanish client)

engineer.description: Web application for crop monitoring integrating data analysis with Python and Google Colab. Nightly sync to AWS QLDB for immutable IoT sensor traceability and real-time visualizations with Matplotlib/Seaborn.
highlights: IoT sensor data analysis with Python + Google Colab
Immutable data traceability with AWS QLDB
Real-time visualizations and automated crop alerts

auditorias-datos.title: Audits with data analysis
auditorias-datos.shortDescription: Interactive data analysis system for audits in the power sector (ISA CTEEP)

engineer.description: For ISA CTEEP, a Brazilian power transmission company: turned a manual Excel review into an interactive system with advanced filters and visual prioritization, with automated PDF/Excel report generation.
highlights: From manual Excel review to an interactive system with advanced filters
PDF/Excel reports generated server-side for massive datasets
+60% operational efficiency with visual prioritization

caso-arquitectura.title: Case Study: Systems Analyst
caso-arquitectura.shortDescription: Full systems-analysis cycle for an architecture firm: requirements gathering, UML, DFD and 13 Scrum sprints

engineer.description: Interactive case study covering the full systems-analysis cycle: requirements gathering, feasibility study, objectives and scope, requirements, modeling (UML, ERD, DFD, state diagram), architecture design, and a Scrum methodology with 13 documented sprints.
highlights: 14 navigable chapters: from initial requirements gathering to production rollout
Custom-built diagrams (class, use case, ERD, DFD, state, deployment) instead of static screenshots
Full backlog, burndown, and traceability between requirements and delivered features

coca-cola-embonor.title: Corporate expense web system
coca-cola-embonor.shortDescription: User/permission management + SAP integration for Coca-Cola Embonor

engineer.description: User, group and permission management modules for a responsive solution, with SAP integration to automate accounting processes.
highlights: User, group and permission modules (hundreds of daily transactions)
SAP API integration for accounting automation
-75% manual errors

mundial-2026.title: 2026 World Cup prediction model
mundial-2026.shortDescription: Elo rating, Poisson and Monte Carlo simulation to estimate each team's probability, validated against the real tournament

engineer.description: Relative strength model (Elo), expected goals (Poisson) and full bracket Monte Carlo simulation. Strict time cutoff: no prediction uses information after the tournament started.
highlights: Predicted both semifinals correctly and ranked Spain 2nd favorite (16%); Spain won
Elo calibration validated on thousands of historical matches
Honest comparison against logistic baseline and naive lines (log-loss)

abandono-estudiantil.title: Student dropout prediction
abandono-estudiantil.shortDescription: Risk model to prioritize tutoring: who to intervene with first when resources are limited

engineer.description: Pilot (POC) on the UCI dataset (4,424 students). Logistic regression vs. Random Forest, decision threshold as a business dial and a prioritized student list.
highlights: Detects 65.8% of dropouts with only the 1st semester, in time to intervene
Operational threshold 0.53 optimized by F1 (precision 0.88, recall 0.72)
Full CRISP-DM journey with management artifacts (Sprint 0, DRL sheet, backlog)
